summary: This roadmap derives the inert anticyclotomic CM main conjecture from the proved integral signed local decomposition and integral elliptic-unit theory. It keeps the Gross Q-curve, avatar coefficient ring, primitive normalization and dual actions explicit, then obtains finite-character CM rank bounds with the parity-dependent local correction. It plans the global comparison and control arguments rather than repeating the local-unit or general Selmer theories.

nodes.title: The inert Gross CM datum
nodes.statement: An inert CM datum is the tuple in the standing hypotheses, with the actual Hecke character, Gross CM curve, rank-one avatar lattice, embeddings and differential/period comparison. It also records the chosen p-adic place of H. This is input data on imported carriers, not a new CM-curve or Hecke-character theory. Coefficient extension R→R′ transports T by tensor product, W by the induced discrete quotient, and Λ_R by completed scalar extension.
hypotheses: p≥5 is prime and inert in the imaginary quadratic field K; p does not divide h_K. H is the Hilbert class field.
